name: Sarume Shinonome
source:
"...Pfch, I can't believe I just got talked down to by some shorty from the flat chest clan."

A member of the Kunai Organization's Capital Branch, who have been clashing with the ayakashi since ancient times.

She lives in the Capital Branch's hidden village, located nearby Uji. She lacks a bit of common sense due to not setting foot outside the village much.

[url=/c39166]Ren's[/url] childhood friend and the same age as her, they both used to play together often.

A wielder of one of the village's Divine Swords, which grant their wielder abilities far beyond what any regular human can achieve.

Rarely gets too excited, but can be prone to goofing off now and then. Also a fan of calling Ren out whenever possible.

[From the official [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/ne-no-kami-a-yuri-vn-of-demons-spirits-and-love#/]IndieGoGo page[/url]]
